title: Icons Demo
description: Demonstration MicroSim showing how to add clickable Creative Commons license and fullscreen icons to the control region. Uses distance-based click detection and opens links in new tabs.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: User Interface Design
Interaction Design
Web Development
Event Handling
Click Detection
learningObjectives: Explain how mousePressed() uses the dist() function to test whether a click falls within an icon's radius
Identify where the Creative Commons and fullscreen icons are positioned relative to the control region coordinates
Implement a clickable icon in a p5.js sketch using the drawIcons() and mousePressed() pattern shown here
Evaluate the roughly 40-line code cost of adding icons against the benefit of in-sketch license and fullscreen access
Distinguish drawing an icon in draw() from detecting its click in mousePressed()
